# langsmith_organizations (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith **organizations** the authenticated identity can access via GET [`/api/v1/orgs`](https://api.smith.langchain.com/openapi.json). Each element matches OpenAPI `OrganizationPGSchemaSlim`. For only the current organization (GET `/api/v1/orgs/current`), use the `langsmith_organization` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_organizations" "all" {}

output "organization_ids" {
  value = [for o in data.langsmith_organizations.all.organizations : o.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable placeholder (`organizations`) so the data source can be referenced.
- `organizations` (Attributes List) Organizations returned by the API, sorted by `id` for stable Terraform state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339), if present.
- `created_by_ls_user_id` (String) Creating LangSmith user id, if present.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Creating user id, if present.
- `default_sso_provision` (Boolean) Default SSO provisioning flag.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the organization is disabled.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `engine_enabled` (Boolean) Engine enabled flag from the API, if present.
- `id` (String) Organization UUID.
- `invites_enabled` (Boolean) Whether invites are enabled.
- `ip_allowlist` (List of String) IP allowlist CIDRs or entries (sorted in state for stable plans).
- `is_personal` (Boolean) Whether this is a personal organization.
- `jit_provisioning_enabled` (Boolean) Just-in-time provisioning flag.
- `llm_auth_proxy_allowed_urls` (List of String) Allowed URLs for the LLM auth proxy (sorted in state).
- `llm_auth_proxy_enabled` (Boolean) LLM auth proxy enabled flag.
- `llm_auth_proxy_jwt_audience` (String) LLM auth proxy JWT audience, if set.
- `max_api_key_expiry_days` (Number) Maximum API key expiry in days, if set.
- `max_pat_expiry_days` (Number) Maximum PAT expiry in days, if set.
- `max_service_key_expiry_days` (Number) Maximum service key expiry in days, if set.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification time (RFC3339), if present.
- `pat_creation_disabled` (Boolean) Whether PAT creation is disabled.
- `public_sharing_disabled` (Boolean) Whether public sharing is disabled.
- `restrict_browser_secrets` (Boolean) Whether browser secret access is restricted.
- `scim_group_name_separator` (String) SCIM group name separator (API default `:` when absent).
- `security_contact` (String) Security contact email, if set.
- `sso_login_slug` (String) SSO login slug, if configured.
- `sso_only` (Boolean) Whether SSO-only login is enforced.
- `tier` (String) Plan tier (`PaymentPlanTier` in OpenAPI), if set.
- `workspace_admin_can_invite_to_org` (Boolean) Whether workspace admins may invite to the org.
